stage_0_infrastructure.name: Stage 0: Contracts & Infrastructure Setup
stage_0_infrastructure.description: Pure TypeScript Interface Contracts definition, PixiJS v8 foundation, RenderEngineAdapter spike and Parallel Canvas mount harness.

infrastructure_deliverables.description: Pure TypeScript definitions (IRenderEngine, IRenderNode, ISpriteNode, IGraphicsNode, ITextNode, IScene, ISceneManager)
Architecture Decision Records: ADR 001 (Adapter Pattern), ADR 002 (Hybrid UI DOM/Canvas), ADR 003 (Decoupled Physics), ADR 004 (Parallel Canvas Transition)
PixiContainerNode, PixiSpriteNode, PixiGraphicsNode, PixiTextNode wrapping PixiJS v8 native nodes
RenderEngineAdapter implementing IRenderEngine with PixiJS v8 and Docker/Vite safe DOM lifecycle
Formal SceneManager with FSM (IDLE, EXITING, SWITCHING, ENTERING, ERROR) replacing k.scene() and k.go()
Pure TypeScript tween and easing engine replacing k.tween()
Canonical syntax equivalence table mapping Kaboom.js API calls to Adapter Pattern equivalents

stage_1_leaf_systems.name: Stage 1: Autonomous Leaf Systems
stage_1_leaf_systems.description: Autonomous procedural shaders, background effects, weather, particle systems, caustics, and camera math with zero inward dependencies on gameplay state.

stage_2_ui_layer.name: Stage 2: UI Layer, Modals & Navigation
stage_2_ui_layer.description: Menus, HUD, Modals, Options and Codex screens migrated to accessible DOM overlay and responsive adapter components according to ADR 002.
